messages:
support_oncall: Heads up — acme-corp outage: they report 401s + elevated latency on Private VPC since ~02:15 UTC. Billing spike observed. root_req=r-3a9f... attaching repro steps.
amanda_ong: ticket link? tenant id? need sample curl + response body to repro.
support_oncall: Ticket: TCK-4821. tenant=acme-corp. Sample curl -> 
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx' https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate
=> HTTP/1.1 401 {"error":"token invalid"}
```
raj_patel: I reproduced against a staging node with their VPC config. Seeing client retry loops causing CPU pressure on edge proxies. Also intermittent KMS timeouts around 02:12-02:18 -> a bunch of 500s in the runtime logs.
luis_gomez: Could be NAT/egress conntrack exhaustion. If KMS calls fail, we retry and create more sockets.
sec_bot: ALERT: high KMS retry rate for tenant=acme-corp at 2024-06-01T02:12:xxZ (metric:kms.retry_rate) :warning:
emily_product: Customer says their audit logs for 02:10-02:20 are missing — they need compliance evidence for that window.
raj_patel: Pulled tcpdump from a dedicated node and netstat: many sockets in CLOSE_WAIT. Conntrack count near max on the NAT box. Snippet:
```
sudo sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count
# -> 261900
sudo sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max
# -> 262144
```
amanda_ong: If conntrack ~= max, NAT drops new flows -> KMS timeouts -> service retries -> increased latency + billing. Options: raise nf_conntrack_max, scale NAT pool, or reduce connection churn (offload/keepalive).
support_oncall: Customer cannot change their corporate firewall rules (they're strict about ephemeral ports). They asked whether we can provide a stable egress IP or pinned endpoint so their FW team will allow it.
luis_gomez: We can provision a tenant-specific SNAT pool (static egress IPs) for Private deployments. Need infra sign-off and an IP allocation.
raj_patel: Repro steps I ran: repeated curl to KMS endpoint -> initial timeouts -> token cache miss -> subsequent auth attempts return 401 because token TTL expired while retries piled up. Log excerpt:
```
2024-06-01T02:13:05Z token-cache: miss tenant=acme-corp key=kms-key-1
2024-06-01T02:13:08Z kms: timeout client=10.2.5.8 req_id=r-3a9f
2024-06-01T02:13:10Z auth: 401 token-invalid tenant=acme-corp req_id=r-3a9f
```
emily_product: We need to export audit logs (02:10-02:20) and provide a signed delivery for compliance. Can SRE pull from the log-shipper (elk/gcs) and package? Also mark this incident as compliance-impacting.
sec_bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-egress-kms (action items: pull tcpdump, audit logs, request temporary SNAT).
amanda_ong: Next actions: (1) SRE (raj) pull full tcpdump + export audit logs for window; (2) Infra (luis) request temporary SNAT for tenant; (3) Security (amanda) review KMS retry/backoff + token cache TTL; (4) Support update customer with repro + ETA. Assigning: @raj_patel, @luis_gomez, @support_oncall.
support_oncall: On it. Updating TCK-4821 with repro + asking customer for their allowed egress IP list and any firewall ACLs.
luis_gomez: Opening infra request INC-1729 to allocate tenant SNAT (ETA ~30m). Adding note: ensure IPs are advertised in region-us-west1.
raj_patel: Pushed temporary mitigations: reduced max concurrent KMS retries for acme-corp to 2 and bumped token-cache TTL to 60s. KMS error rate down ~70% in monitored window. Continuing to monitor.
support_oncall: Thank you — customer appreciates speed. I'll follow up in 30m with status. :thumbsup:
